events.title: Aquaria KLCC
events.overview: Aquaria KLCC ialah taman dalam air yang terletak di bawah Pusat Konvensyen Kuala Lumpur dalam kawasan pembangunan KLCC. Meliputi kawasan 60,000 sq ft dalam dua aras dengan terowong bawah air sepanjang 90 meter, Aquaria KLCC menempatkan lebih 20,000 hidupan daratan dan air dari lebih 250 spesies berbeza dari dalam dan luar negara. Juga terdapat pondok maklumat interaktif mengenai pemuliharaan hidupan laut, serta kawasan peruncitan bertema seluas 5,000 sq ft.
events.overviewEn: The Aquaria KLCC is an oceanarium located beneath Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre within Kuala Lumpur City Centre in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
events.overviewKo: 아쿠아리아 KLCC는 말레이시아 쿠알라룸푸르에 있는 수족관이다. KLCC는 쿠알라룸푸르 시티 센터의 머리 글자를 딴 것으로 그 이름 그대로 쿠알라룸푸르 중심부에 위치한다. 아쿠아리아 KLCC는 2003년에 건설을 시작하여 2005년에 완성, 같은 해 8월에 개관했다.
events.posterCredit: Phalinn Ooi from Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia / CC BY 2.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

events.title: Galeri Wei-Ling
events.overview: Galeri Wei Ling ialah sebuah galeri seni yang terletak di Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, yakni di kawasan Brickfields. Galeri ini diasaskan oleh Lim Wei-Ling pada 2002 untuk menggalakkan secara aktif karya artis kontemporari Malaysia dan budaya Malaysia. Koleksi galeri menawarkan gambaran keseluruhan seni moden dan kontemporari, termasuk karya seni bina dan reka bentuk, lukisan, lukisan, arca, fotografi, cetakan, media elektronik dan buku artis. Galeri ini juga merupakan penerbit terbesar buku artis di Malaysia, dengan lebih 100 judul atas nama mereka dan telah bekerjasama rapat dengan banyak penaja korporat, termasuk HSBC, United Overseas Bank, Hong Leong Bank, Nippon Paint, Absolut Vodka,…
events.overviewEn: Wei-Ling Gallery is a contemporary art gallery in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, founded in 2002 by Lim Wei-Ling. It is committed to the development of contemporary art in Malaysia, encourages passion for art, and supports the next generation of young emerging artists. The gallery has published over 121 art publications in Malaysia, which include exhibition catalogues, brochures, and artists' books.

stops.title: Kuala Lumpur Tower
stops.text: The Kuala Lumpur Tower, colloquially referred to as KL Tower, is a 421-meter-tall telecommunication tower in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It is the world's seventh-tallest telecommunication tower. It features an antenna which increases its height to 421 metres. The roof of the pod is at 336.5 metres. The rest of the tower below has a stairwell and an elevator to reach the upper area, which also contains a revolving restaurant, providing diners with a panoramic view of the city.
stops.textKo: 쿠알라룸푸르 타워, 통칭 KL 타워는 말레이시아 쿠알라룸푸르에 있는 6층, 421-미터-tall 높이의 방송탑이다. 세계에서 7번째로 높은 탑이다. 안테나를 포함하여 높이가 421 미터이다. 포드의 지붕은 335 미터에 있다. 탑의 나머지 부분은 계단과 엘리베이터를 통해 상부 지역으로 연결되며, 이곳에는 도시의 탁 트인 전망을 제공하는 회전 레스토랑도 있다.

stops.title: Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Kuala Lumpur
stops.text: The Metropolitan Archdiocese of Kuala Lumpur, shortened as Archkl, is an ecclesiastical territory or diocese of the Catholic Church in Malaysia. It was erected as the Diocese of Kuala Lumpur by Pope Pius XII on 25 February 1955, and was elevated to the rank of a Metropolitan Archdiocese on 18 December 1972, with the suffragan sees of Malacca-Johor and Penang. It also administers the capital city of Malaysia, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur as well as the federal administrative centre of Putrajaya and the urbanised states of Selangor and Negeri Sembilan in the central region as well as Pahang and Terengganu on the East Coast. The archdiocese's Mother Church and thus, seat of its Archbishop, is St. John's Cathedral.
stops.imageCredit: User:Two hundred percent. / CC BY-SA 3.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

stops.title: Sultan Abdul Samad Jamek Mosque
stops.text: Jamek Mosque, officially Sultan Abdul Samad Jamek Mosque is one of the oldest mosques in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It is located at the confluence of the Klang and Gombak rivers and may be accessed via Jalan Tun Perak. The mosque was designed by British architect and soldier Arthur Benison Hubback, and built in 1909. It was the principal mosque of Kuala Lumpur until the construction of the national mosque Masjid Negara in 1965. The name "Jamek" is the Malay equivalent of the Arabic word jāmiʿ meaning a place where people congregate to worship.
stops.textKo: 자멕 이슬람 사원은 1909년에 세워진 말레이시아의 모스크이다. 우아한 자태를 자랑하는 가장 오래된 쿠알라룸푸르의 이슬람 사원이며, 유연한 곡선미와 돔 등 이슬람 문화의 특징을 발산하고 있는 건물이다.

stops.title: Sultan Abdul Samad Building
stops.text: The Sultan Abdul Samad Building is a late-19th-century building located along Jalan Raja in front of Dataran Merdeka and the Royal Selangor Club in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The building originally housed the offices of the British colonial administration, and was known simply as Government Offices in its early years. In 1974, it was renamed after Sultan Abdul Samad, the reigning sultan of Selangor at the time when construction began. The building once housed the superior courts of the country: the Federal Court of Malaysia, the Court of Appeals and the High Court of Malaya; the Federal Court and the Court of Appeals relocated to the Palace of Justice in Putrajaya in 2003, while the High Court of Malaya shifted to the Kuala Lumpur Courts Complex in Segambut in 2007. Later, it housed the offices of the Ministry of Communications and Multimedia and the Ministry of Tourism and Culture of…
stops.textKo: 술탄 압둘 사마드 빌딩은 영국 식민지 시대인 1897년에 건축된 건물로 주요 행정부의 부서로 사용되었다. 도시를 대표하는 건물로 40m 높이의 시계탑과 햇볕을 받으면 우아하게 빛나는 구리로 만든 돔이 덮여 있어 새해를 맞는 신성한 의식과 국가독립기념일의 시가행진 및 국가행사에 중심적인 역할을 하는 곳이다. 이 유서깊은 건물은 현재 대법원과 섬유박물관으로 사용되고 있다.

stops.title: Independence Square
stops.text: Independence Square is a square located in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It is situated in front of the Sultan Abdul Samad Building. It was formerly known as the Selangor Club Padang, or simply the Padang, and was used as the cricket green of the Selangor Club. It was here that the Union Flag was lowered and the Malaysian flag hoisted for the first time at midnight on 31 August 1957. Since then, the Independence Square has been the usual venue for the annual Independence Day Parade.
stops.textKo: 므르데카 광장은 말레이시아 쿠알라룸푸르에 있는 광장이다. 술탄 압둘 사마드 빌딩 앞에 위치해있으며 1957년 8월 31일 자정 말레이시아의 독립이 선포되고 광장의 국기 게양대에 걸려있던 유니언 잭을 끌어내리고 잘루르 그밀랑을 게양한 광장이다.
stops.imageCredit: Haakon S. Krohn / CC BY-SA 3.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

stops.title: National Mosque of Malaysia
stops.text: The National Mosque of Malaysia is a mosque in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It has a capacity for 15,000 people and is situated among 13 acres of gardens. Its key features are a 73-metre-high minaret and a 16-pointed star concrete main roof. The umbrella, synonymous with the tropics, is featured conspicuously – the main roof is reminiscent of an open umbrella, the minaret's cap a folded one. The folded plates of the concrete main roof are a creative solution to achieving the larger spans required in the main gathering hall.
stops.textKo: 마스지드 느가르는 말레이시아 쿠알라룸푸르에 위치한 모스크이다. 총 15,000명 수용이 가능하며 13에이커 정도 되는 아름다운 정원에 위치해 있다. 마스지드 느가르는 서말레이시아 발음이며 '마스지드 느가라'라고도 한다. 영어명칭인 국립 이슬람 사원으로도 알려져 있다. 건물의 원구조물은 말레이시아 공공사업국에 소속된 3명이 이룬 팀이 설계했다.

stops.title: Berjaya Times Square
stops.text: Berjaya Times Square is a 48-storey, 203 m twin tower, comprising a hotel, condominium, indoor amusement park, commercial offices and shopping centre complex in Bukit Bintang, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It was opened to the public in 2003.
stops.textKo: 버자야 타임스 스퀘어는 말레이시아의 쿠알라룸푸르에 있는 트윈 타워의 복합 시설이다. 쇼핑 센터와 2개의 5성급 호텔이 입주해 있다. 버자야 그룹이 소유하고 있다. 2003년 10월에 당시 수상이었던 마하티르 빈 모하맛에 의해 개설되었다. 두 탑은 모두 높이 203m, 48층이다.
stops.imageCredit: CEphoto, Uwe Aranas / CC BY-SA 3.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

stops.imageCredit: Phalinn Ooi from Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia / CC BY 2.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

events.title: Memorial Tun Abdul Razak
events.overview: Memorial Tun Abdul Razak merupakan sebuah bangunan kediaman rasmi Tun Abdul Razak di Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia yang pada asalnya dikenali sebagai Bangunan Sri Taman. Bangunan ini kemudiannya telah dijadikan muzium bagi memperingati jasa beliau serta dirasmikan oleh Perdana Menteri Mahathir Mohamad pada 6 Mei 1982. Tun Abdul Razak telah mendiami bangunan ini semenjak tahun 1962 sehingga beliau menghembuskan nafas terakhir pada bulan Januari 1976.
events.overviewEn: The Tun Abdul Razak Memorial is an official residence building of Tun Abdul Razak in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia which was originally known as the Sri Taman Building. This building was later turned into a museum to commemorate his services and was inaugurated by Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad on 6 May 1982. Tun Abdul Razak had lived in this building since 1962 until he died in January 1976.
events.posterCredit: Radosław Botev / CC BY 3.0 pl (Wikimedia Commons)

stops.title: Ampang Jaya
stops.text: Ampang Jaya, more commonly known as just Ampang, is a town, a mukim and a parliamentary constituency straddling parts of the Hulu Langat District and Gombak District, in eastern Selangor, Malaysia. It is located just outside the eastern border of Kuala Lumpur Federal Territory. It is administered by the Ampang Jaya Municipal Council, which is the formal name of the township as well.
stops.textKo: 암팡자야는 말레이시아 슬랑오르주의 군으로, 면적은 143.5km2, 인구는 721,411명이며 말레이시아에서 5번째로 큰 도시이다. 말레이시아로 이주한 한국인이 거주하면서 형성된 한인 타운이 있다.
stops.imageCredit: User:Two hundred percent / CC BY-SA 2.5 (Wikimedia Commons)

stops.title: As Syakirin Mosque
stops.text: The As Syakirin Mosque, also known as KLCC Mosque, is a mosque located in the Kuala Lumpur City Centre, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The mosque is situated near the Suria KLCC shopping centre and the Petronas Twin Towers, the tallest twin towers in the world. In 2009, the mosque went through a major renovation to increase the capacity from 6000 people to 12,000 people. Mosque initially registered as a prayer on 12 July 1999 for Petronas staff, and status as a mosque before being administered by the Federal Territory Islamic Religious Council. This two-storey mosque area of 21 hectares.

stops.title: Petronas Tower 3
stops.text: Petronas Tower 3, also known as Carigali Tower, is a 60-story, 267-meter-tall skyscraper in KLCC, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It is Malaysia's eighth tallest building and it is also part of the Petronas Towers complex. The 246-meter high building also features a 21-meter high crown-like structure on the top of the tower, making it 267 meters high. The building features a 6-level extension to the Suria KLCC shopping mall, while the rest of the floors above are solely made up of office spaces. It is the headquarters of Petronas Carigali, the E&P subsidiary of Petronas and some of the local subsidiaries of Multinational Corporations such as Microsoft Malaysia.

stops.title: Kuala Lumpur Bird Park
stops.text: Kuala Lumpur Bird Park is a 20.9-acre public aviary in the Malaysian capital of Kuala Lumpur. It is one of the world's largest covered bird parks, located adjacent to the 60-hectare Perdana Botanical Gardens, Kuala Lumpur Butterfly Park, the National Mosque, and the Royal Malaysian Police Museum. The park houses more than 3,000 birds, representing over 200 species in an enclosed aviary. About 90% are local birds and 10% were imported from countries such as Australia, China, the Netherlands, Indonesia, Papua New Guinea, Tanzania, and Thailand.

stops.title: Planetarium Negara
stops.text: The National Planetarium is the national planetarium of Malaysia. It is a blue-domed structure that is situated on top of a hill in the Lake Gardens at Jalan Perdana, Kuala Lumpur. It is about 120,000 square feet in area.

stops.title: National Museum of Malaysia
stops.text: The National Museum is a public museum in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia dedicated to Malaysian art, culture, and history. Located on Jalan Damansara close to Perdana Lake Gardens across KL Sentral station. Its façade comprises elements from both traditional Malay and modern features. It was inaugurated on 31 August 1963. The National Museum is a three-story structure, 109.7 metres long and 15.1 metres wide, which is 37.6 metres high at the central point.
stops.textKo: 국립박물관은 말레이시아 쿠알라룸푸르에 있는 공립 박물관으로, 말레이시아의 예술과 문화, 역사에 관해 전시하고 있다. 페르다나 식물원 근처 잘란 다만사라 도로에 위치해 있으며, KL 센트랄역 맞은편에 있다. 박물관의 외관은 전통 말레이 양식과 현대적 요소가 결합된 형태로 구성되어 있다. 1963년 8월 31일에 개관하였으며, 말레이시아의 문화적·역사적 유산을 보존하는 기관으로 기능하고 있다. 국립박물관은 3층 규모의 건물로, 길이 109.7미터, 폭 15.1미터, 중앙부의 높이는 37.6미터에 달한다.

stops.title: Perdana Botanical Gardens
stops.text: Perdana Botanical Gardens, formerly Perdana Lake Gardens, Lake Gardens, and Public Gardens, is Kuala Lumpur's first large-scale recreational park. Measuring 91.6 hectares, it is located in the heart of the city and established in 1888. The park served as place of refuge from the hustle and bustle of the city during colonial times. It contains large sculpted and manicured gardens and a host of attractions.
stops.textKo: 페르다나 식물원은 말레이시아 쿠알라룸푸르 최초의 대규모 도시 공원이다. 면적은 91.6헥타르로, 도심 한가운데에 위치해 있으며 1888년에 조성되었다. 식민지 시대 도시의 번잡함을 피해 휴식을 취할 수 있는 피난처 역할을 했다. 현재도 잘 가꿔진 정원과 다양한 명소를 갖춘 공원으로 사랑받고 있다.

events.title: Muzium Kesenian Islam
events.overview: Muzium Kesenian Islam Malaysia merupakan muzium yang pertama dan terbesar di rantau Asia Tenggara yang dikhususkan bagi kesenian Islam. Ia terletak di Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia dan dibuka pada 12 Disember 1998. Bangunan Muzium Kesenian Islam ini direka oleh rakyat Malaysia yang mempamerkan keindahan senibina Islam. Ciri-cirinya yang paling menonjol adalah binaan lima kubah.
events.overviewEn: The Islamic Arts Museum Malaysia is a museum in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It was officially opened on 12 December 1998. The museum is the largest museum of Islamic arts in Southeast Asia with more than seven thousands artifacts from the Islamic world.
events.overviewKo: 말레이시아 이슬람 미술관는 말레이시아 쿠알라룸푸르에 있는 미술관이다. 1998년 12월 12일에 공식적으로 개관했다. 이 미술관은 이슬람 세계에서 7천 점이 넘는 유물을 소장하고 있는 동남아시아에서 가장 큰 이슬람 미술 박물관이다.

events.title: Muzium Negara
events.address: Muzium Negara, Jalan Damansara, 50566 Kuala Lumpur
events.overview: Muzium Negara merupakan salah sebuah bangunan yang unik di Malaysia. Muzium Negara merupakan sebuah muzium yang terletak di Jalan Damansara, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Muzium ini terletak berhampiran dengan Taman Tasik Perdana. Muzium Negara ini mempunyai gabungan reka bentuk istana Melayu tradisional digabungkan citarasa yang moden.
events.overviewEn: The National Museum is a public museum in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia dedicated to Malaysian art, culture, and history. Located on Jalan Damansara close to Perdana Lake Gardens across KL Sentral station. Its façade comprises elements from both traditional Malay and modern features. It was inaugurated on 31 August 1963.

events.title: Muzium Numismatik Maybank
events.overview: Muzium Numismatik Maybank merupakan salah satu daripada muzium yang terdapat di Kuala Lumpur. Muzium Numismatik Maybank terletak di dalam Menara Maybank di Jalan Tun Perak. Muzium Numismatik Maybank terletak pada tingkat bawah bangunan ini dan mempamerkan himpunan wang kertas dan duit syiling dari awal sejarah Kesultanan Melayu, tempoh koloni, sehingga masa kini, termasuk mata wang negara Asean. Ia mempunyai himpunan duit syiling terbesar di Malaysia.
events.overviewEn: The Maybank Numismatic Museum is a museum in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, that is run and owned by the Maybank. It holds one of the largest coin and money collections in Malaysia. The museum is housed in Maybank Tower at Jalan Tun Perak. In September 2012, the museum was closed to the public for renovations, and has subsequently been reopened.
events.posterCredit: Img by Calvin Teo / CC BY-SA 3.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

events.title: Muzium Orang Asli
events.overview: Muzium Orang Asli ialah sebuah muzium di Gombak, Selangor, Malaysia yang mempamerkan sejarah dan tradisi masyarakat peribumi Orang Asli. Muzium ini merangkumi sebuah perpustakaan dan sebuah dewan teater kecil. Muzium ini dibuka pada 29 September 1987 oleh Perdana Menteri pada masa itu, Mahathir Mohamad.
events.overviewEn: The Orang Asli Museum is a museum in Gombak, Selangor, Malaysia that showcases the history and tradition of the indigenous Orang Asli people. It includes a library and a small theater hall, and was opened on 29 September 1987 by Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad.

events.title: Muzium Petaling Jaya
events.overview: Muzium Petaling Jaya ialah muzium di Petaling Jaya, Daerah Petaling, Selangor, Malaysia. Ia mempamerkan sejarah dan pembangunan Petaling Jaya.
events.overviewEn: The Petaling Jaya Museum is a museum in Petaling Jaya, Petaling District, Selangor, Malaysia. It showcases the history and the development of Petaling Jaya.

events.title: Muzium Sejarah Nasional
events.overview: Muzium Sejarah Nasional merupakan sebuah muzium yang terletak di pusat bandar Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Ia terletak bersebelahan dengan Dataran Merdeka. Muzium ini dibuka pada 4 April 1996 dan merupakan muzium kebangsaan kedua selepas Muzium Negara. Bagaimanapun pada 2007, muzium ini telah ditutup dan koleksi dipindahkan ke Muzium Negara.
events.overviewEn: The National History Museum was the second national museum in Malaysia after the National Museum. It was located opposite Dataran Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur. As of November 2007 it is closed and the entire collection has been moved to the National Museum. National History Museum exhibited unique historical development of the homeland of the early days until now.
events.overviewKo: 국립역사박물관은 말레이시아 국립박물관에 이어 두 번째로 설립된 말레이시아의 국립 박물관이었다. 쿠알라룸푸르의 므르데카 광장 맞은편에 위치해 있었다. 2007년 11월을 기준으로 박물관은 폐관되었으며, 소장 유물은 모두 국립박물관으로 이전되었다. 국립 역사 박물관은 선사시대부터 현대에 이르기까지의 말레이시아 역사를 전시하였다.
events.posterCredit: User:Two hundred percent / CC BY-SA 2.5 (Wikimedia Commons)

events.title: Muzium Seni Asia
events.overview: Muzium Seni Asia merupakan sebuah muzium yang terletak di Universiti Malaya,Kuala Lumpur. Muzium Seni Asia telah dibuka secara rasmi pada tahun 1980 dan ditempatkan di dalam bangunan tiga tingkat yang terletak di antara Fakulti Undang-undang dan Fakulti Ekonomik dan Pentadbiran. Muzium ini memuatkan sehingga 2,000 kepingan seramik dari Malaysia, Thailand, Kemboja, Vietnam, China, Jepun, India dan Iran. Selain seramik, muzium ini juga mempunyai koleksi kendi terbesar di dunia dan artifak bersejarah seperti keris picit yang dikatakan dibentuk dengan menggunakan jari.
events.overviewEn: The Museum of Asian Art is a museum located in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The museum is dedicated to showcasing different art forms in various parts of the Asian continent.
events.overviewKo: 아시아 미술관은 말레이시아 쿠알라룸푸르에 위치한 미술관이다. 아시아 대륙 각 지역의 다양한 예술을 소개하는 데 목적을 두고 있다.

events.title: Muzium Sultan Alam Shah
events.overview: Muzium Sultan Alam Shah atau juga dikenali sebagai Muzium Shah Alam terletak di bandar Shah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia. Bangunan muzium ini dibina mengikut seni bina moden, bersebelahan Perpustakaan Shah Alam, di tepi Tasik Shah Alam.
events.overviewEn: Sultan Alam Shah Museum is a museum in Shah Alam, Petaling, Selangor, Malaysia. It is the state museum of Selangor. This museum was opened in 1989 by Sultan Salahuddin Abdul Aziz Shah.

events.title: Pusat Sains Negara
events.overview: Pusat Sains Negara merupakan sebuah taman tema berkonsepkan sains dan teknologi yang terletak di Bukit Kiara, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Pusat ini juga adalah sebuah institusi pendidikan tidak formal di bawah seliaan Kementerian Sains, Teknologi dan Inovasi Malaysia. Misi PSN adalah untuk mencetus dan menyemai minat rakyat Malaysia ke arah pembelajaran sains dan teknologi sepanjang hayat. Objektif PSN pula adalah untuk memupuk kesedaran, kefahaman dan penghayatan orang ramai terhadap sains dan teknologi.
events.overviewEn: Pusat Sains Negara or National Science Centre is a science centre in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Perched atop a hill on 8 hectares of landscaped grounds at Bukit Kiara on the northwestern fringes of the city, the centre was officially opened on 29 November 1996 by Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad. The main aim of the science centre is to promote greater understanding and interest in science and technology. The building resembles a truncated cone capped with a geodesic dome.

events.title: Rimba Ilmu
events.overview: Rimba Ilmu ialah sebuah taman botani tropika yang ditubuhkan oleh mendiang Profesor WR Stanton pada tahun 1974 di kampus Universiti Malaya di Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Taman ini mempunyai lebih 1,600 spesies tumbuhan yang menduduki lebih 80 hektar. Ia dihuni terutamanya dengan spesies tumbuhan asli tetapi termasuk banyak dari Asia tropika, kepulauan Pasifik, Australia, Amerika Selatan, Afrika dan Madagascar. Persatuan Pencinta Alam Malaysia mengadakan program alam sekitar dengan kerjasama universiti di taman botani sejak 1997.
events.overviewEn: Rimba Ilmu is a tropical botanical garden set up by the late Professor W.R. Stanton in 1974 on the campus of the University of Malaya in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The garden has over 1,600 species of plants occupying over 80 hectares. It is populated mainly with indigenous plants species but include many from tropical Asia, the Pacific islands, Australia, South America, Africa and Madagascar.
events.overviewKo: 림바 일무는 1974년 고 W.R. 스탠튼 교수가 말레이시아 쿠알라룸푸르 말라야 대학교 캠퍼스에 설립한 열대 식물원이다. 80헥타르가 넘는 면적에 1,600종 이상의 식물이 자라고 있다. 주로 토착 식물종으로 이루어져 있으나, 열대 아시아, 태평양 제도, 호주, 남미, 아프리카 및 마다가스카르에서 온 식물들도 다수 있다.

events.title: Taman Burung Kuala Lumpur
events.overview: Taman Burung Kuala Lumpur ialah sebuah taman burung terletak berhampiran dengan Tasik Perdana di Kuala Lumpur negara Malaysia. Ia berukuran 20.9 ekar. Ia terletak Di sekitar kawasan ini terdapat pelbagai pusat pelancongan lain seperti Taman Rama-Rama, Masjid Negara, Taman Bunga Raya, Balai Peringatan Tun Abdul Razak, Planetarium Negara dan lain-lain. Taman Burung ini telah dirasmikan oleh Seri Paduka Baginda Raja Permaisuri Agong, Tuanku Siti Bainun binti Mohd Ali pada 15 November 1991.
events.overviewEn: Kuala Lumpur Bird Park is a 20.9-acre public aviary in the Malaysian capital of Kuala Lumpur. It is one of the world's largest covered bird parks, located adjacent to the 60-hectare Perdana Botanical Gardens, Kuala Lumpur Butterfly Park, the National Mosque, and the Royal Malaysian Police Museum. The park houses more than 3,000 birds, representing over 200 species in an enclosed aviary. About 90% are local birds and 10% were imported from countries such as Australia, China, the Netherlands, Indonesia, Papua New Guinea, Tanzania, and Thailand.

events.title: Zoo Negara
events.overview: Zoo Negara Malaysia ialah sebuah zoo negara yang pertama di Malaysia dan diuruskan sepenuhnya oleh Persatuan Zoologikal Malaysia iaitu sebuah pertubuhan bukan kerajaan yang memainkan peranan utama dalam hal ehwal konservasi hidupan liar, penyelidikan, pendidikan dan rekreasi. Ia mula dirasmikan pada tahun 1930 oleh Perdana Menteri Malaysia yang pertama, Al-Marhum Tunku Abdul Rahman Putra Al-Haj. Zoo Negara bermula dengan koleksi induknya yang kini telah berkembang sehingga 459 spesies hidupan liar. Zoo yang dihuni kira-kira 5000 haiwan ini telah mengalami banyak transformasi dengan konsep pameran secara terbuka untuk keselesaan haiwan dan juga para pengunjung.
events.overviewEn: The National Zoo is a Malaysian zoo located on 110 acres of land in Ulu Klang, Gombak District, Selangor, Malaysia. It was officially opened on November 14, 1963, by the country's first prime minister, Tunku Abdul Rahman. The zoo is managed by a non-governmental organization known as the Malaysian Zoological Society and is home to 3,072 animals of 327 different species. It received MS ISO 9001:2008 certification in July 2007 and is a member of the South East Asian Zoos Association.
events.overviewKo: 말레이시아 국립동물원은 말레이시아 슬랑오르주 Ulu Klang에 있는 동물원이다. 1963년 11월 14일 문을 열었다.
